description: This file defines the ColumnCellIterator class, which is used to iterate over cells in a specific column of a worksheet within the PhpSpreadsheet library. It provides methods for setting iteration range, moving through cells, and retrieving current cells.

classes.name: ColumnCellIterator
classes.description: An iterator for traversing cells in a specific column of a worksheet, supporting range limits and cell existence management.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the column iterator with the worksheet, column index, start row, and optional end row.

methods.name: resetStart
methods.description: Resets the starting row and repositions the iterator to the start.

methods.name: resetEnd
methods.description: Sets the ending row for iteration.

methods.name: seek
methods.description: Sets the current row to a specific position in the iteration range.

methods.name: rewind
methods.description: Resets the iterator to the starting row.

methods.name: current
methods.description: Returns the current cell in the column at the current row position.

methods.name: next
methods.description: Advances the iterator to the next row.

methods.name: prev
methods.description: Moves the iterator to the previous row.

methods.name: valid
methods.description: Checks if the current position is within the iteration range.

methods.name: adjustForExistingOnlyRange
methods.description: Adjusts start and end range based on existing cells when in 'only existing cells' mode.
